title: Read an array position
summary: Fortran: Read an array position. Read scores(3).
introduction: Fortran arrays normally start at position 1. Parentheses select an item.
learningObjectives: Read an array position with Fortran

blocks.text: Install GNU Fortran. Save each example as lesson.f90, run gfortran -std=f2008 lesson.f90 -o lesson, then run it.

blocks.title: Read an array position
blocks.code:
program lesson
  implicit none
integer :: scores(3) = [4, 5, 8]
write(*,'(I0)') scores(2)
end program lesson

blocks.text: Fortran starts ordinary array bounds at 1. Position 2 contains 5.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Do not assume array indexing starts at zero.
